SLG reference_type_ids.nameOf duplicates54 CSharp TypeId names/values. Intrinsic nominal tables and allocation/box sentinels also copy numeric enum values. Replace those raw identities with generated enumName/enumValue in the existing namespace.

Use existing SelfHostPolicy generated-region path in the already-manifested reference_type_ids.slg; extend it to enum metadata and embed the authoritative BoundProgram.cs resource. No new dependency manifest or protected original source-list edit is required.

CSharp65 exporter proof passed before any SLG integration. Preserve normal nominal registration and box ordering logic, exact intrinsic names and public TypeName contract. This unit automates enum identity data; intrinsic declaration-name policy remains a separate source decision.

Extend existing automatically discovered policy runtime probe to the enum projection, actual named identities and missing boundaries; then test actual nameOf and existing nominal/ABI controls on both compilers.
